Translate all other English (common nouns, adjectives, verb metaphors). When translating, prefer the established target-language term (a word actually used in documents written by native speakers); if none exists, prefer a loanword form in common use; otherwise keep the English term inside backticks with a short parenthetical gloss on first use. Never invent literal calques that do not exist in the target language, and keep one consistent rendering per concept within a document.
